question: Who among the following inaugurated 2-day PM Kisan Samman Sammelan of India in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Narendra Modi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Narendra Modi inaugurated the 2-day PM Kisan Samman Sammelan of India in October 2022.**

 
 
• The PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of India in 2019 to provide financial assistance to small and marginal farmers.
 
• PM Narendra Modi Launched Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi From Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh.
